gloss: how filling food is; staying power of food

definitions.gloss: how filling food is; how long food keeps you full
definitions.explanation: The quality of food in terms of how long it keeps you feeling full after eating. Almost always used with がいい (filling, keeps you full) or がわるい (not filling, wears off quickly).

examples.japanese: おにぎりは{腹持|はらも}ちがいい。
パンは{腹持|はらも}ちが{悪|わる}いからすぐお{腹|なか}が{空|す}く。
examples.english: Bread isn't very filling, so I get hungry again quickly.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}ごはんには{腹持|はらも}ちのいいものを{食|た}べた{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: It's better to eat something filling for breakfast.

notes: A compound of {腹|はら} (stomach) + {持|も}ち (lasting/holding). Almost always appears in the fixed patterns {腹持|はらも}ちがいい (filling) or {腹持|はらも}ちが{悪|わる}い (not filling). Also used as a modifier: {腹持|はらも}ちのいい{食|た}べ{物|もの} (filling food). There is no English word that corresponds exactly; the closest equivalents are 'filling' or 'satisfying' when talking about food.
